method: ismayc/tracking-study d21f8e3c reproduced exactly (docs/validation/EXTERNAL_REPLICATION.md); per-game argmax of shot-team agreement over lead grid 0-8 s by 0.5; turnovers held out
sign_convention: tracking_clock = pbp_clock + lead (lead > 0 <=> PBP stamp lags tracking); unit test in clock_latency_calibration.py --self-test

lead_quality_classes.CLOCK_CALIBRATION_VALIDATED: CALIBRATED, held-out turnover agreement >= 0.80, not bimodal-within-one-event at >= 1.0 s separation, |lead_H1-lead_H2| <= 2.0 s
lead_quality_classes.AMBIGUOUS_LEAD: top-2 peaks within one event and >= 1.0 s apart

curve_shape_columns: plateau_width_* / rising_edge_lead_s / n_local_maxima_within_0p02 / curve_rates (17 grid points 0.0..8.0) are DESCRIPTIVE inputs for the curve taxonomy; they do not change any lead
known_limitation: the argmax lead sits a median ~1.0 s above the rising edge of plateau-shaped curves; no plateau-aware rule is applied; v1 preserves the source-exact method
rules: every stage reads this table and only this table for leads; no stage may alter a lead; no downstream outcome may ever feed back into it
